title: Pointwise multiplication morphism of polynomial Proj twists
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $P=\operatorname{Proj} k[x_0,x_1]$ [def-sc-p1-standard], and $L_n=\mathcal O_P(n)$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. There exist morphisms $\mu_{n,m}:L_n\otimes L_m\to L_{n+m}$ for all integers $n,m$, with $\mu_{n,m}(s\otimes t)(x)=s(x)t(x)$ in the prime localization for every open $U$, sections $s\in\Gamma(U,L_n)$ and $t\in\Gamma(U,L_m)$ and point $x\in U$. The tensor product and its pure-tensor section are those of [lem-pc-sites-sheaf-tensor-bilinear-universal]. No invertibility, tensor-power identification or coordinate locus is asserted.

proof.text: Multiply twisting sections pointwise in the prime localizations. The degree-addition rule and isLocallyFraction_mul show the product is a section of the sum-degree twist. The ring laws show bilinearity and restriction compatibility.

Apply the existing sheaf tensor bilinear universal property to this actual bilinear family. Its factorization formula is exactly the definition of tmulSection, so evaluating at a point gives the asserted product formula.

theorem projectiveLine_twist_product_morphism (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    ∃ μ : ∀ n m : ℤ,
        Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) n ⊗
          Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) m ⟶
            Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (n + m),
      (∀ (n m : ℤ) (U : (Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Opens)
        (s : Γ(Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) n, U))
        (t : Γ(Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) m, U)) (x : U),
        (((μ n m).app U (tmulSection s t)).1 x :
            Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) =
          (s.1 x : Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) * (t.1 x))
